description: Non-SEO proof: pre-authoring completeness gate for research briefs. Verifies the data sources a brief will reference have the required fields. Same engine as core-30-completeness, different artifact class.

required_fields.rationale: City name is the brief's subject identity.
County alignment is a required section in city-base-research briefs.
State is needed for jurisdiction-specific research (permits, utilities).
Client name is needed for client-fact-research brief subject.
Owner name is needed for accounts-ownership verification.
Website URL is needed for NAP consistency checks.
